# Junaid Akram, PhD — Academic Profile

> Source Code Security Assessment (SCSA) Research Lab
> COMSATS University Islamabad, Lahore Campus

## Profile

Dr. Junaid Akram is an Assistant Professor, HEC-approved PhD supervisor, former postdoctoral researcher at SnT, University of Luxembourg, and PhD graduate of Tsinghua University.

## Research

- Cyber Security
- Software Vulnerability Detection
- Software Testing and Test Data Generation
- Malware Detection
- Code Clone Detection and Analysis
- Software Evolution, Maintenance, and Reuse
